// Shape modelled on the public kingpin usage in prometheus/prometheus
// cmd/prometheus (Apache-2.0). Names and structure are trimmed; this is not
// a verbatim copy.
package main

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/alecthomas/kingpin/v2"
)

func main() {
	a := kingpin.New(filepath.Base(os.Args[0]), "The server")
	a.Version("1.0")
	a.Flag("web.listen-address", "Address to listen on.").Default("0.0.0.0:9090").StringVar(&addr)
	a.Flag("storage.path", "Base path.").Default("data/").StringVar(&path)
	a.Flag("web.enable-lifecycle", "Enable lifecycle.").Default("false").BoolVar(&lc)
	a.Flag("enable-feature", "Comma separated features.").Hidden().StringsVar(&features)
	_, err := a.Parse(os.Args[1:])
	_ = err
}
